location.section: Book 6, part 3: the frameworks of philosophy (tenet systems)

paraphrase: Among the tenet systems the Madhyamaka is presented in two forms: the self-emptiness Madhyamaka of Nāgārjuna's reasonings (Svātantrika and Prāsaṅgika), and the other-emptiness Great Madhyamaka of the Maitreya treatises and the definitive third turning, set out as the summit of the sūtra tenets. Each is valid in its own sphere: the self-empty approach cuts through conceptual elaboration in study and reflection, the other-empty view is suited to meditative experience.
speaker: Jamgön Kongtrul
